messages:
Brianna: quick standup — yesterday: finished refactor of slot allocator in kernel, pushed change to reduce contention between microbatches. merged PR into canary branch. noticed p95 regressions on long-seq workloads in bench-v2 (around seq=2048).
Kevin: can you paste the bench command you used? I can try to repro locally.
Brianna: yep running: `./bench --profile bench-v2 --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --warmup 200` also toggled batching.flags.enable_fair_slotting=true.
Li: sounds like the fair slotting change could interact with KV priming. we saw similar p95 spikes when eviction and priming overlap. any KV metrics?
Brianna: KV heatmap shows hotset churn around those requests, eviction rate spikes ~3x during the p95 windows. attaching small log snippet: ```evict loop: processed=128 ttl_queued=40 evictions=32```
Omar: ping on the kernel PR review — left a few nits around the atomic update in slot table. I can approve once tests pass.
Brianna: thanks Omar — pushed fix for atomic ordering. CI green but canary still has the tail.
Kevin: I'll spin your exact command on a DGX with same CUDA driver and compare. if I repro, i'll run with `--batch-size=1..16` sweep to see batch sensitivity.
Li: if you can, try toggling `kv.prefetch.window=64` vs 256. previously a smaller window reduced long-seq tail at the cost of throughput.
Brianna: plan for today: run bench sweep across batching sizes + prefetch window, collect p50/p95/p999, and if we find a sweet spot open a canary config. also will add a microbenchmark that isolates slot steal path.
Kevin: I'll coordinate to run the same sweep on dedicated-canary-2 (region-us-west2). will post results by EOD.
Omar: free to reassign a code-owner if you want a faster merge — I can own the followups.
Brianna: appreciate it. blocker: need access to dedicated-canary-2 — getting a permissions 403 when trying to kick a bench job. @Kevin can you confirm role bindings?
Kevin: ah yeah, recent infra change removed bench-runner role from dev group. filing infra ticket now, should be quick.
deploy-bot: Canary job created: canary/kern-refactor/1861234321 (id: canary-7b3). status: queued.
SRE-bot: FYI — there will be a transient alert if p95 exceeds 350ms for >5min during the canary. tagging oncall. (reaction :bell:)
Brianna: noted — i'll keep an eye. will post a one-line update in this thread after the sweep.
Omar: thx — if you need me to jump on debugging later break out the reproducer and I'll join.
Brianna: will do. end.
